## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Thüringen lights up on the map of Germany.
> Thüringen | Landeshauptstadt Erfurt

[dramatic] [[Thüringen]], Thuringia, in the middle of the country, is a Freistaat. Its capital is Erfurt. In nearby Weimar, Goethe and Schiller lived and wrote, and in 1919 Germany's first democratic constitution was drawn up there.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Thuringia, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> THÜRINGEN

## On the map

{Q458}

> SCENE (question): Question card #458. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Thüringen?]] Which federal state is Thuringia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[2]]. Number two: the middle of the country, a little to the east.


{Q457}

> SCENE (question): Question card #457. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Thüringen heißt …]] The state capital of Thuringia is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Erfurt.]] The other three are real cities in Thuringia, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q455}

> SCENE (question): Question card #455. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Thüringen?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Thuringia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[weiß-rot]]. White and red.


{Q451}

> SCENE (question): Question card #451. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Freistaat Thüringen?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the Free State of Thuringia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 4]], picture four: a lion striped red and white on blue, with eight white stars.


## How it's run

{Q452}

> SCENE (question): Question card #452. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Thüringen?]] Which of these is a district in Thuringia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Wartburgkreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Ammerland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], and [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]].


{Q453}

> SCENE (question): Question card #453. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Thüringen gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Thuringia elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q454}

> SCENE (question): Question card #454. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Thüringen bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are people allowed to vote in local elections in Thuringia?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q459}

> SCENE (question): Question card #459. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Thüringen?]] What is the head of government in Thuringia called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q460}

> SCENE (question): Question card #460. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Thüringen nicht?]] Which minister does Thuringia not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q456}

> SCENE (question): Question card #456. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Thüringen über politische Themen informieren?]] Where in Thuringia can you find information on political topics?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Erfurt, weiß-rot, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Erfurt]]. [[weiß-rot]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
